meta.name: The Gone Game 720p
meta.description:
In the midst of a pandemic, Sahil Gujral goes missing. Thought to be a victim of the coronavirus at first, his death points to a mysterious crime. Sahil's sister and father takes matter into their own hand to find what actually happened.

Ended · First aired 20 Aug 2020 · India · Language: Hindi

Complete series. On your server: S1 4/4 | S2 5/5

On your server — Audio: Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: Gone
videos.overview: Unprecedented. Unreal. Unbelievable. 2020 has left the world in utter shock but for the Gujral family, the trauma has just begun. Sahil Gujral is gone. Has he become another statistic in a series of virus-inflicted deaths? Or is a more sinister game at play?

videos.title: The Trail
videos.overview: The Gujrals have barely gotten over the shock of Sahil's disappearance when his sister, Amara, gets a phone call. With 'Bhai' flashing on the screen, can Amara make sense of what's happening?

videos.title: The Blood on Your Hands
videos.overview: Locked down, helpless, and inconsolable, the Gujral family is given a tiny ray of hope. The answer to Sahil's disappearance may finally come to light…but at what cost?

videos.title: Game Over
videos.overview: You play the gone game or get played, either way, there's no escape!

videos.title: Revenge is Sweet
videos.overview: Suhani Gujral makes a shocking announcement when she is released from jail. Will she finally expose the truth or is this the start of another dangerous game?

videos.title: The Usual Suspects
videos.overview: A murder, a coverup and a nation-wide manhunt. Investigating officer Sharmila Gupta confronts the family but time is running out.

videos.title: No Turning Back
videos.overview: Sahil Gujral is out of options and looking for an escape. The noose around the Gujral family gets tighter as they struggle to find a way out. Will the pressure finally get to them?

videos.title: Keep Your Enemies Close
videos.overview: Rajiv Gujral reaches out to an old foe in order to make new friends. Amara's investigation lands her in trouble as Sahil inches closer to his destination.

videos.title: Time Is Up
videos.overview: All roads lead to destruction as the Gujrals find themselves backed into a corner. Will they protect one another, or will someone be sacrificed at the altar of lies?
